[openai-gpt-6-astra-system-card] Irregular evaluated Astra across three offensive cybersecurity evaluation 96 OpenAI suites: FrontierCyber, CyScenarioBench, and Irregular’s Atomic Challenges suite.
[openai-gpt-6-astra-system-card] On CyScenarioBench, which tests long-horizon offensive tasks, Astra solved 9/10 challenges at least once, compared with 6/10 for GPT-5.6-Sol.
[openai-gpt-6-astra-system-card] (cited release-decision or scoring sentence) Its average success rate was 59%, an increase of 32 percentage points.
[openai-gpt-6-astra-system-card] (cited release-decision or scoring sentence) Note that this version of the evaluation is closer to saturation, but also more signal-bearing, than the original MLE-Bench. 104 OpenAI Figure 56 10.2 Safeguards GPT-6 Astra is our first model to reach the cyber critical threshold.
[openai-gpt-6-astra-system-card] (cited release-decision or scoring sentence) For expert-led assessments, we internally tested Astra’s ability to exploit hardened browser and operating system targets, and also conducted third- party testing with Irregular. 88 OpenAI As noted in the safeguards section, we have strengthened our cyber safe- guards across the stack, and have updated our Trusted Access for Cyber program, to mitigate the increased risks associated with a cyber critical model. 10.1.2.1 ExploitBench ExploitBench is a benchmark that evaluates whether models can turn known V8 N-day vulnerabilities into progressively stronger exploit primitives against a hardened, production-like JavaScript engine.
[openai-gpt-6-astra-system-card] (cited release-decision or scoring sentence) By incorporating trusted institutional and contextual signals, the program helps us support advanced scientific work without relying solely on broad restrictions that may unnecessarily impede legitimate research. 10.2.6.2 Cybersecurity - Trusted Access for Cyber Trusted Access for Cyber, also known as Daybreak access, helps qualified organizations and practitioners use advanced cybersecurity capabilities for authorized defensive work.
[openai-gpt-6-astra-system-card] (cited release-decision or scoring sentence) Irregular estimated API costs per successful solution, across all benchmarks, at roughly one-third those of GPT-5.6-Sol, assuming identical per-token pricing.
[openai-gpt-6-astra-system-card] (cited release-decision or scoring sentence) Irregular reported conducting evaluations in sandboxed environ- ments without public internet access.
